seal.statement: Phase 0.3 locking reads use one deterministic fail-fast reservation-conflict policy: the partition transaction participant owns acquire/conflict/release of durable replicated reservations, DistributedTransactionCoordinator owns transaction lifetime and cross-participant rollback/recovery, a conflicting reservation returns a typed refusal instead of entering a waiter queue, any multi-participant reservation conflict aborts and rolls back the whole transaction so no hold-and-wait state exists, timeout/cancellation/commit/rollback/recovery release through transaction ownership, and deadlock is impossible in the initial slice because no wait graph is created.
